claim_one_line: THE WORDINGS-WEAVE CLAIMS OF 18 OCTOBER, VERIFIED (NEGATIVE; a verification arc of a separate session's unsealed arc, banked under its number; P-198): no postulate of Table 1 is discharged. On the puncture module L6 the moves generate 2O (order 48, commutant 2) and RL^2R acts as diag(i,-i,...), so L6 is reducible; irreducibility (order 192) needs P_a, P_b added by hand, the paper's Proposition 24. The 4D index on M_{1,2} is asserted (Leray degeneration typed in; H^2 of the compactification has rank 2, not 1); the E8 steps are classical branching plus identifications (matter in (27, 3_T), a typed-in hypercharge). What holds: the four shears L_ab, L_ba, R_ab, R_ba generate Aut+(F2) (the wording discrepancies are conj(a^-1), conj(b^-1)); RL^2R, LR^2L lift to P_a, P_b on W10's V; L6 = (chi_eta^3 rho_T) (x) V_2 under Mp2(Z) with the level-2 theta doublet; Gate 12 (P-074) closes to shear-word length 7 after an odd eta-twist (67 284 automorphisms: 2 950 conflicts untwisted, 0 twisted). 0 of 19.
